claim: Geopolitical bias in large language models is not solely attributable to pre-training data composition, as evidenced by a model (Qwen 2.5) whose base is neutral despite Chinese-language pre-training, while its post-trained chat shows strong pro-China bias.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by examining other models with known pre-training language composition and comparing base and post-trained bias.

conditions: tested on Qwen 2.5 base and chat models
base model pre-trained primarily on Chinese-language data but neutral on China-favourability (-0.15 log-odds)
post-trained chat shows strong pro-China bias (+2.91 log-odds)
exclusions: limited to the forced-choice probe methodology
transferability to other models or pre-training corpora is unestablished

title: Post-training vs. pre-training data–geopolitical bias mechanism
